// diagnostic E3010

Jet.ArithmeticOrBoundsFailure

`{msg}`

What

`{msg}`

Why

The operands or position do not produce a valid result, so the safe runtime stops instead of returning corrupted data — with Jet file and line.

Fix

Check the operands or bounds before the operation, or use a checked operation that returns an outcome.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ArithmeticOrBoundsFailure: Tests/UI/comptime_dependency_panics.stderr.

Error: Jet.ArithmeticOrBoundsFailure: `no value`
  --> Tests/UI/comptime_dependency_panics.jet:5:12
    |
  5 | BASE: #run boom()
    |            ^^^^
 Why: Compile-time code stopped the build: a `panic`, a failed check or an unhandled failure in a `#run` value is a compile error
 Fix: Handle the failure inside the `#run` block (`??` or an `.Ok`/`.Err` match), or fix the value the check rejects
